privacy.private: Only the presenter can read it. No name is attached unless you add it.
privacy.count: The screen shows a count when a question arrives.
privacy.kept: Questions are kept so the presenter can read them later.

outcome.noAck: It may not have arrived. Sending it again is safe.
outcome.tooFast: Wait a few seconds before sending another.
outcome.tooMany: You have sent as many questions as this room allows.
outcome.full: This room cannot take more questions.
outcome.notPlayer: You are no longer in this room.
outcome.notLecture: This room does not take questions.

inbox.title: Questions
inbox.curtainNote: Questions stay hidden until you show them, and hide again when you leave this page.
inbox.deleteRecordBody: All its questions are removed for good.
inbox.failed: That did not go through. Try again.
inbox.framed: Open this page on its own, not inside another page.
